environment.capacity: Salias 1 MiB per-producer ring versus Aeron 1 MiB term in a multi-term log; total mapped capacities differ
environment.aggregation: Median and range across measured run values; latency uses each run's worst subscriber, never pooled histograms
environment.payload_limit: Full verification checks every payload byte, producer identity, per-producer sequence, ordering, and duplicates
